verdicts.reason: A keeps the TRAVEL / MAKEUP / KIT order, but the boxes are shrunk to small labels spread over huge gaps, so the title no longer reads as one headline. The background has obvious mismatched horizontal bands from the stretched image, and the makeup imagery has been cropped away to bare slate. B has the same broken banded background and is worse: it puts MAKEUP before TRAVEL, so the title reads 'MAKEUP TRAVEL KIT', and KIT sits far below and much larger than the other two words, so the title falls apart.
